text:
maria: heads up — I found a public gist that contains an encoded blob that looks like a KMS-wrapped Vault token for staging. link: https://gist.github.com/REDACTED :rotating_light:

samir: can you paste the blob (sanitized) and any headers? need to confirm wrapped vs plain token

maria: pasted sanitized snippet:
```
vault-enc: CIAAAA...base64...==
kms-cipher: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rw-keys/cryptoKeys/vault-wrap
```

beth: ok, assume compromise until proven otherwise. immediate actions: 1) revoke the exposed token (if it's a Vault token) 2) check Vault audit logs for usage 3) rotate any service account / KMS keys used to unwrap 4) patch any deployments with rotated creds 5) create incident ticket and notify customers if prod data was accessed.

kevin: on it. Maria — can you DM me the original gist link and the file path inside repo? i'll start a quick search for other occurrences with grep.

maria: DM sent. i also ran a quick scan across public org gists and found 2 more matches referencing the same key name but different blobs.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0883
Details: public exposure -> possible KMS-wrapped Vault token. Assigned: eng-security. Severity: P2.

samir: steps i'll run now:
```
# revoke suspected vault token (if we can derive token id)
vault token-revoke -id=<token-id> || true

# if token id unknown, generate a new root/approle creds and rotate binding for staging
# rotate/unbind any GCP SA keys used to call KMS
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=staging-deploy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# revoke suspicious keys
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete <KEY_ID> --iam-account=staging-deploy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

beth: also add these: increase audit log retention for Vault for 30d, snapshot current audit logs, and export KMS CryptoKey versions activity. i'll raise a short runbook for oncall to follow.

kevin: rotated the staging-deploy SA keys and updated k8s secrets in staging with new wrapped tokens. pushed a canary deploy to one cluster. rolling now. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks. i also started a simple grep across infra repo: `git grep -n "rw-keys/cryptoKeys/vault-wrap" -- .` found references in deploy scripts. creating PRs to remove any hardcoded references.

samir: i've pulled audit logs from Vault (last 24h) and filtered for the token id pattern — no unusual read/write patterns in prod; only staging read activity from the CI runner 2026-03-19 02:13 UTC. attaching log excerpt to the incident.

beth: good. still treat as leak. action owner: kevin for rotation/patching (done), samir for log triage (in progress), maria for repository cleanup (PRs), beth for incident coordination & postmortem.

ops-bot: automated rotation script triggered: /scripts/rotate-kms-wrapped-vault.sh --env=staging --force; started job 4372

sec-bot: Note: update RBAC for CI runners — remove broad unwrap permissions and create narrow delegation for only required keys. Recommend creating a short-lived work account for CI to reduce blast radius.

maria: agree. i'll draft the RBAC change and post to #eng-platform for review. also proposing we add a pre-commit check to block commits that match base64 blobs > 200 chars in repo.

beth: adding postmortem owner and timeline: initial detection -> 1887654321, rotation completed -> 1887654620, audit logs reviewed -> 1887654820. postmortem due EOD tomorrow.

kevin: quick follow-up — no customer data exfil found in audit logs so far. i'll keep the canary under watch for 48h.

maria: thanks team. filing follow-up tasks: JIRA SEC-1246 (rotate KMS key policy + RBAC tighten), SEC-1247 (audit retention bump & export), DEVX-543 (pre-commit base64 check).

samir: final note — we should consider key rotation automation for the vault wrap key on a 90-day cadence. created a short RFC draft in google drive, will ping later. :lock:

beth: closing thread for now; will re-open in incident channel if new findings pop up. :white_check_mark:
